announced on Friday that their proposed merger received its fourth regulatory approval from the Illinois Commerce Commission.
has also received approvals in Virginia, Ohio, and Kentucky, with additional state reviews ongoing.
The shareholders of both companies have approved the all-stock deal, and the federal antitrust waiting period has expired.
The combined company will serve more than 4.7M water and wastewater connections and 740K natural gas connections under the American Water name.
The merger is expected to close by the end of the first quarter of 2027, subject to remaining approvals.

title: American Water Works, Essential Utilities merger advances with Illinois approval
